## 2024-05-13 - Expo Web Playwright Accessibility Limitations
 **Learning:** React Native's `accessibilityRole="button"` and `accessibilityLabel` do not always cleanly map to standard ARIA attributes in the DOM generated by Expo Web, causing Playwright `page.get_by_role()` locators to time out during visual verification.
 **Action:** Prioritize adding these accessibility props for native screen readers, but rely on broader CSS selectors or full-page visual checks when testing Expo Web via Playwright.
